purpose: Visual identity explorations, not implemented UI. Demo fixtures and virtual currency only.

prompts.name: tribune
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity original visual identity and Android app UI proposal for BETVERSE, a French football prediction game using ONLY virtual currency called Verse. This is a serious, achievable shipped-product design, not concept-art. Inspiration is the readability, compact fixture lists and disciplined interaction hierarchy of professional sports apps; do NOT copy Betclic or Winamax branding, logos, exact layouts or marketing.
Deliver one sharp landscape design presentation with exactly TWO large straight-on Android screen designs side by side, each completely visible including status and bottom navigation bars. Screens should occupy most of the board with readable UI text, minimal outer framing. Put a small design-direction title and original typographic BETVERSE wordmark above. A slim palette strip and a one-line French identity description below. No photographic phone devices, no perspective, no hands. Two screens have identical dimensions, realistic Android proportions, no iPhone notch.
Both screens use a consistent 5-tab bottom navigation with simple line icons and labels: "Accueil", "Matchs", "Mes paris", "Agence", "Profil". Screen 1: Matchs tab active. Compact BETVERSE header with balance "1 250 V", profile avatar. Main heading "Matchs"; sports selector "Football", "Tennis", "Basket" with Football active. Date selector "Aujourd'hui", "Demain", "Cette semaine". Section "Ligue des champions" and "Données de démonstration". Three compact upcoming fixture rows with home and away teams stacked and small original team monograms, no official badges. "Paris SG" vs "Arsenal", kickoff "21:00", odds three equally sized touch targets labelled "1  2,10", "N  3,40", "2  3,15"; selected home odds clearly active. Next "Inter" vs "Dortmund", "21:00", "1  1,85", "N  3,60", "2  4,20". Next "Lyon" vs "Porto", "21:00", "1  2,45", "N  3,20", "2  2,80". Fixture rows efficient enough to see all three with comfortably tappable controls, no enormous decorative crests. Bottom sticky summary above navigation "Paris SG · 2,10" and button "Voir mon pari". Do not use LIVE or imply live data.
Screen 2: same underlying app with an expanded nearly full-height bottom sheet showing a simple bet confirmation. Header "Mon pari", a close icon; small "Pari simple"; "Paris SG — Arsenal"; selection "Victoire Paris SG", "Cote 2,10". Input "Mise en Verse" with "100", quick amounts "50", "100", "250", "500". Summary "Solde disponible 1 250 V", "Gain potentiel 210 V", supporting caption "Mise incluse". One clear full-width primary button "Confirmer · 100 V". Footnote "Monnaie virtuelle · Aucun gain en argent". All French text carefully typeset, clean aligned baseline grid, tabular odds numerals, body legible and contemporary. Practical whitespace. Avoid gradients, glowing borders, glassmorphism, floating 3D coins, galaxy imagery, trophies as decoration, promo ads, euro signs, fictitious live activity, over-rounded pill everything, tiny unreadable text, or feature clutter. Do not render code or design annotations inside app screens.
Identity: TRIBUNE. Graphite sport utility, decisive high contrast, original angular BV monogram with a subtle chevron, clean condensed bold headings and humanist sans body. Deep neutral graphite #151719 canvas, raised surfaces #222528, chalk #F4F4EE text, acid yellow-green #D7F75B reserved for active state and confirmation CTA with dark lettering. Secondary inactive odds slightly lighter graphite; strong legible dividers, restrained 8px corners. No blue or purple. Palette board background cool light gray. Board title "01 — TRIBUNE", description "Graphite, précision, énergie sportive". Mature professional sports product with consistent dense readable rows; no betting-brand imitation.
